name: Valorcall Pass
summary: Valorcall Pass is a strategic crossroads situated right outside the ruined gates of Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. Named after Lieutenant Valorcall, this contested stretch of road serves as a critical approach to the ancient human citadel. Control over this pass dictates access to the fortress and marks the boundary of local skirmishes in the highlands.

sections.title: Gateway to Stromgarde
sections.body: Positioned just outside the perimeter of Stromgarde Keep, Valorcall Pass functions as the primary crossroads leading into the historic fortress city. The road bears the name of Lieutenant Valorcall, an officer who once patrolled this strategic intersection. In an unstable region dominated by Syndicate brigands, Witherbark forest trolls, and contending faction forces, holding this pass is essential for anyone seeking passage into the ruins of Stromgarde.

faq.answer: It is a prominent crossroads and pass located in the Arathi Highlands, situated immediately before the gates of Stromgarde Keep. It controls the main approach into the ancient stronghold.

faq.q: Why is it named Valorcall Pass?
faq.answer: The pass is named in honor of Lieutenant Valorcall, an officer who historically patrolled and guarded the roadways outside the fortress.

faq.q: Why is this crossroads strategically important?
faq.answer: Because it lies directly at the threshold of Stromgarde Keep, whoever controls Valorcall Pass effectively controls reinforcement lines, retreats, and direct access to the citadel itself.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Valorcall Pass is the vital corridor connecting their surviving defenders in the highlands to the remnants holding out inside the historic citadel of Stromgarde.
The Horde eyes this critical crossroads to monitor movements around Stromgarde and cut off Alliance efforts to reoccupy the fallen kingdom.
